chunks: And in another Hadith, by this chain
He (peace be upon him) said: 'The different (items), two similar (portions bartered) with one, hand to hand, there is no problem'.

key_terms.الْمُخْتَلِفُ: Different items (referring to different types of food/commodities)
key_terms.مِثْلَانِ بِمِثْلٍ: Two similar portions with one (referring to unequal quantities of different items)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for exchanging different types of food or commodities in Islam?
ai.summary: This narration clarifies that when exchanging different types of foodstuffs (diverse species), the quantity may vary as long as the exchange is immediate ('hand to hand'), distinguishing it from same-species exchanges which require equal weight. This ruling is rooted in the Prophetic tradition regarding *Riba al-Fadl*, where the prohibition of excess applies to specific commodities only when measured or weighed, not when traded by count or volume across different kinds. It highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the immediacy of possession (*Qabd*) as a key condition for valid barter in these transactions.

en.hubeali: And in another Hadeeth, by this chain,
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The different (items), two similar (portions bartered) with one, hand to hand, there is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 17. In another Hadith through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith
it is narrated thatexchange of two different kinds of goods at the same time is not harmful.’”
